findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：關稅與報復性關稅可能提高被投資組合公司成本、壓縮利潤並降低競爭力，已對部分在美國有大量實體商品銷售的公司造成不利影響；2026年2月最高法院裁定多項關稅越權，政府隨後改以其他法律課徵全球關稅，後續走向不明。
findings.excerpt: Increased tariffs on goods imported from China, Canada, Mexico and other countries could further increase, costs, decrease margins and reduce the competitiveness of products and services offered by our portfolio companies. This has and could further adversely impact the revenues and profitability of select companies that have substantial sales of physical goods in the U.S.

findings.claim: 10-K 指出美國對中國實體的制裁與出口管制，以及美中貿易戰升級，可能影響投資機會與全球成長，進而影響各基金被投資組合公司的營收與獲利。
findings.excerpt: Further escalation of the “trade war” between the U.S. and China, the countries’ inability to reach further trade agreements, or the continued use of reciprocal sanctions by each country, may negatively impact opportunities for investment as well as the rate of global growth, particularly in China
